newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai confirms Sega deal.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai confirms Sega deal.

text.p: South Korea's Hyundai Group on Monday confirmed a Japanese newspaper report that it planned to set up a joint venture in Seoul with Sega Enterprises Ltd of Japan to import arcade game equipment.
"The (Nihon Keizai Shimbun) report is true, but a final contract has yet to be signed," said a spokesman for Hyundai Corp, Hyundai Group's foreign trading unit.
Hyundai Corp would hold a 75 percent stake of the joint venture's capital of about five billion won and the remainder will be held by Sega, he said.
The joint venture will import both finished products and components for local assembly from Japan, he said.
The devices will not be sold to consumers but will be installed at games arcades that another Hyundai Group unit, Hyundai Electronics Industries Co, plans to open next year, he said.
He declined to give further details.
